summary: Two hunters in their 30s from Gypsum stranded by heavy snow and blowing snow in the Deep Creek canyon area; friends tried but failed to reach them; the pair huddled under a blown-down tree with a fire overnight and were airlifted in the morning by Classic Air Rescue at GSAR's direction, flown to Glenwood Springs and met by GSAR personnel.
responding_agency: Garfield County SAR; Classic Air Rescue
notes: Resolves the parked Nov-2024 Deep Creek canyon lead (7 prior date-pin attempts). Date APPROXIMATE: the GCSO 2024-11-18 release says 'early November'; pipeline convention = first of month. Third paragraph of the GCSO Nov-2024 release — ids 2260/2261 cover its first two incidents.
